title: Masky
description: Masky AI avatars that speak, plus scene video, images and live conversations.
Use it as an agent tool covering the Masky API, or as a pipeline step that turns text into a talking head, a scene clip, an image or a live-conversation turn.
Requires a Masky API key from https://masky.ai/developer

tool_masky.apikey.title: API Key
tool_masky.apikey.description: Masky API key (mky_...). Get one at https://masky.ai/developer. Leave blank to use ROCKETRIDE_MASKY_KEY.

tool_masky.baseUrl.title: API base URL
tool_masky.baseUrl.description: Masky API root. Change only to point at a staging environment.

tool_masky.defaultAvatar.title: Default Avatar
tool_masky.defaultAvatar.description: Avatar id or @handle used when a call or pipeline record names none. Find ids with masky.list_avatars.

tool_masky.defaultLook.title: Default Look
tool_masky.defaultLook.description: A look_id from masky.list_looks, or a look image URL. Blank uses the avatar's default look.

tool_masky.language.title: Language
tool_masky.language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. en, es, fr.

tool_masky.maxCreditsPerCall.title: Max Credits per Call
tool_masky.maxCreditsPerCall.description: Cost guard: refuse any render whose estimate is higher. 0 turns the guard off.

tool_masky.timeoutSec.title: Render Timeout (seconds)
tool_masky.timeoutSec.description: Longest to wait for a render. Scene video can take about 3 minutes.

tool_masky.includeMediaUrls.title: Include Media URLs in Tool Results
tool_masky.includeMediaUrls.description: Turn off when an agent calls this node: results then carry job ids only, so signed URLs stay out of the model's context. Pipeline receipts always include URLs.

tool_masky.readOnly.title: Read-only mode
tool_masky.readOnly.description: When enabled, every agent tool that changes or spends anything (create, train, set, add, speak, generate, edit, conversations and turns, agent binding, visibility, rename, delete, restore) is hidden from the agent rather than merely refused. Listing, get, get_generation and estimate_cost remain. Does not affect the pipeline action. Safe for agents that should only inspect the account.

tool_masky.allowDelete.title: Allow deletion
tool_masky.allowDelete.description: Destructive: enable only when the agent is trusted to delete Masky conversations, turns and agent bindings. Deleted conversations can't be recovered.

tool_masky.allowPublicSharing.title: Allow public sharing
tool_masky.allowPublicSharing.description: Off by default. When off, making an avatar or conversation public, creating a public avatar, and scene video with Share Page Public (agent tools and the scene_video action) are refused. Making something private is never gated.

tool_masky.action.title: Pipeline Action
tool_masky.action.description: What the node does with each text record when it sits in a pipeline. Agent tool calls ignore this.
enum: Image (text is the prompt or edit instruction)

tool_masky.textMode.title: Text Mode
tool_masky.textMode.description: Literal reads the text as written; Personality lets the avatar rephrase it in its own voice.

tool_masky.quality.title: Quality
tool_masky.quality.description: Draft costs about 40% less; 1080p costs about twice 720p.

tool_masky.durationSec.title: Duration (seconds)
tool_masky.durationSec.description: 1 to 20. Ignored when a speech line is set; the line sets the length.

tool_masky.seed.title: Seed
tool_masky.seed.description: Optional. The same seed and prompt give a similar clip.

tool_masky.silent.title: Silent
tool_masky.silent.description: Render the clip without an audio track.

tool_masky.expandPrompt.title: Expand Prompt
tool_masky.expandPrompt.description: Let Masky enrich the prompt. Turn off to use it word for word.

tool_masky.share.title: Share Page
tool_masky.share.description: Masky creates a share page for every clip; choose who can open it.

tool_masky.sourceImageUrl.title: Source Image URL
tool_masky.sourceImageUrl.description: Optional public http(s) image. Scene video animates it; Image edits it, using the incoming text as the instruction.

tool_masky.speechLine.title: Speech Line
tool_masky.speechLine.description: Optional, up to 300 characters. The clip speaks it in the avatar's voice (not lip-synced) and it sets the length.

tool_masky.editEngine.title: Edit Engine
tool_masky.editEngine.description: Used when a source image URL is set. Qwen costs about 3x the default.

tool_masky.conversation.title: Conversation
tool_masky.conversation.description: An existing conversation slug (c-..). Blank creates one per pipeline run; its share and live URLs go out on the text lane.

tool_masky.turnMode.title: Turn Mode
tool_masky.turnMode.description: Chat lets the avatar answer the text; Speak has it say the text as written.

tool_masky.waitForTurn.title: Wait for Each Turn
tool_masky.waitForTurn.description: Wait for each turn to render before sending the next.
